messages:
Sophia N.: Heads-up — Marketing wants to lock the partner announcement for Friday 09:00 PST but legal needs final confirmation that the partner entitlements & billing snapshot are clean. Can we get a quick sanity check?
Aj: Which entitlements exactly? The partner is on the BYO model with trial credits, right?
Sophia N.: Yes — SKU: redwood-pro-bundle, trial_credits=1000, plus a region-restriction flag (eu-only). They want joint press so we need to verify we won't accidentally bill customers before GA.
Kevin: I can run a snapshot of active entitlements and recent usage. Will check for any overlapping legacy SKUs and late ingests.
Lina: Also flag any customers on auto-commit — we had one case where reserved capacity kicked in after a promo and billing got messy.
Aj: Important: partner asked for an embargoed grace window so customers who onboard during the embargo aren't billed until public launch. Do we have a policy for that?
InfraOps: We have a temporary hold mechanism (tagged by launch_id) but it requires the partner to opt in and we need a reconciler job to clear holds after the embargo.
Sophia N.: Can you outline the steps we need to confirm before legal gives the go? Simple checklist would help.
Kevin: Quick checklist proposal:
1) Run entitlement snapshot for launch_id=embargo-0426
2) Validate SKU mapping: redwood-pro-bundle -> partner_sku_42
3) Ensure trial_credits are applied and not auto-converted to billable units
4) Verify hold tags exist and reconciler scheduled after embargo
5) Confirm no active reserved-capacity contracts will bill immediately
(Will run steps 1-3 now)
Aj: If you can paste the SQL you used to generate the snapshot that helps legal/partners audit.
Kevin: Pasting the query I used:
```sql
SELECT customer_id, sku, entitlement_status, trial_credits, launch_tags
FROM entitlement_snapshot
WHERE launch_id = 'embargo-0426'
  AND created_at >= '2026-04-01T00:00:00Z';
```
Lina: Thanks — can you annotate which customers are auto-commit? We can then manually reach out to those accounts.
Kevin: Found 3 accounts with auto_commit=true and trial_credits > 0. Two are in EU, one in US. No reserved-capacity accounts in that set.
Partners Bot: Reminder: please add the legal sign-off document to the partner record: https://redwood.internal/partners/42/docs
Sophia N.: Great — Kevin, can you add a short remediation plan for those 3 accounts? Lina, can your team schedule outreach for the EU customers?
Kevin: Remediation plan (summary):
- Tag the 3 accounts with hold:embargo-0426
- Disable billing pipeline for those accounts until embargo_release_ts
- Run a backfill reconciliation job to ensure usage during embargo is credited, not billed
I will open a small PR to add the hold tag automation.
Lina: Scheduling outreach now. I'll prepare a short message: "You're part of the private launch; no billing will occur until public launch. Reach out if you need to opt out."
Aj: Legal needs the exact embargo_release_ts. What's our proposed timestamp?
Sophia N.: Proposed release: 2026-04-10T16:00:00Z (09:00 PST). Legal, you good with that?
Partners Bot: Legal sign-off pending. SLA: 24h review window.
Sophia N.: Okay — action owners: Kevin (snapshot + PR for hold automation), Lina (customer outreach), Aj (coordinate legal sign-off), InfraOps (ensure reconciler job scheduled). Please update this thread when done. :thumbsup:
InfraOps: Will add reconciler job to the weekly runbook and create a one-off scheduled task to clear hold:embargo-0426 at 2026-04-10T16:05:00Z.
Kevin: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/integrations/pull/2897 — includes tag & billing-disable toggle.
Lina: Outreach messages queued, sending at 2026-04-08T09:00Z local.
Aj: Legal signed off in doc, added comment: "embargo release timing and hold process acceptable."
Sophia N.: Thanks team — keeping this thread as the single source of truth for the go/no-go. If anything changes, ping here.
Kevin: Done — snapshot attached to the partner record.
Partners Bot: Closed loop: hold automation executed for 3 accounts.
Sophia N.: All set, moving to green for Friday announcement pending marketing final assets. :rocket:
